what: The session_008 standard-arm readings: prediction 1 of section 7, section 4.5's step-640 reading and Appendix A's bars; description, committed with the standard arm's readings before any adversarial launch

prediction_1.statement: The new standard arm against the untrained model: every group's first-token echo-free lead falls, and the trigger's fall is smaller than the real-word strings', which is smaller than each of the non-word strings' and the lowercase versions'; the third and fourth tokens move by under 0.6 nat for every group, in the arm mean against the untrained step 0.
prediction_1.test: fall = untrained step 0 minus the standard arm's mean, per group and token (echo_margin[0] to [3]); every first-token fall > 0; trigger < real-word < non-word and real-word < lowercase at the first token; |fall| < 0.6 at the third and fourth tokens for every group

prediction_7.statement: Every step-640 delta on a score is under 0.1 nat, and every firing delta under 4 points.
prediction_7.test: the three runs' mean delta: |mean| < 0.1 on ['ell.trigger', 'ell.real_word', 'ell.non_word', 'ell.lowercase_twins', 'D', 'F', 'trigger_ell_29', 'echo_margin[1].trigger', 'echo_margin[1].real_word', 'echo_margin[1].non_word', 'echo_margin[1].lowercase_twins', 'ell_given_I.trigger', 'ell_given_I.real_word', 'ell_given_I.non_word', 'ell_given_I.lowercase_twins', 'trigger_ell_5']; |mean| < 0.04 on ['strings_firing', 'group_firing.trigger', 'group_firing.real_word', 'group_firing.non_word', 'group_firing.lowercase_twins', 'gate_firing']

per_run_description.note: each run's own delta, description only: prediction 7 is judged on the three runs' mean, as decided after the session_006 per-run values had been seen

appendix_a.what: The bars of the pre-registration's Appendix A, from this standard arm; each row maps to a field below (rows)

thresholds.what: The figures the adversarial arm must reach, given this standard arm (the session_006 table, recomputed); description, entering no verdict

rider_b.margin_rule: the adversarial arm's mean echo-excluded first-token margin at most the standard mean less half of the opening score's fall

capture.rule: every adversarial run must have a capitals opening

share.rule: the larger arm mean of the share, times the capture's fall, at least half of the strings' fall

R_capitals_fire_given_comply.rule: or unreadable: no room in the standard arm, or a run with no complying reply

damage.rule: any adversarial run fails either damage measure, or has an invalid or missing damage readout

lowercase_room.if_breached: the capitals-against-bars contrast is reported as unresolved

interval_spread.rule: the new standard arm's spread enters text 2's Welch interval
